description: Save an OurFamilyWizard date range as an iCalendar (.ics) file the user can import into Google, Apple or Outlook calendar — events, all-day events, and each custody period as a "Parenting time" event (OFW's own export leaves the parenting schedule out). Same filters as ofw_list_events. On a hosted connector the file is uploaded and you get a private download link that expires (default 1 hour); locally it is written inside the attachments directory (OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR, default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp) and you get its path. Never overwrites an existing file. The file is a snapshot: it does not update when OFW changes, and re-importing a later export updates events in place (stable UIDs).

linkMinutes.description: Hosted connector only: how long the download link works, in minutes (default 60, max 1440)

saveTo.description: Local installs only: path or directory (trailing /) INSIDE the attachments directory; relative paths resolve against it. Default: <attachments dir>/ofw-calendar-<start>_<end>-<time>.ics. Ignored on a hosted connector

timeZone.description: IANA zone of the user's OFW account, e.g. America/Chicago. OFW reports wall-clock times with no zone; this is the zone they are read and shown in. Default: the server's DISPLAY_TZ

types.description: Keep only these: EVENT, CONNECTED_EVENT (from a subscribed outside calendar), TRANSITION (custody handoffs; in .ics they become "Parenting time" periods), SCHEDULE (the per-day custody grid, JSON only). Default: everything

name: ofw_save_calendar_ics
